newsitem.title: USA: European American retires 2.1 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: European American retires 2.1 mln shrs.

text.p: European American Resources Inc Monday said it has retired 2.1 million shares of its common stock in exchage for a $7.0 million royalty agreement to the shareholders of the retired shares.
In a statement European American, a mining rights company with assets in Nevada, said the deal reduces the number of issued and outstanding company shares to 7,633,365.

The royalty agreement calls for an annual 10 percent return of net smelter proceeds up to a maximum $7 million. The distribution does not take effect until all expenses by the company are fully recovered.
